title: A property of morphisms of algebraic spaces smooth local on the source and target is checked on one smooth presentation
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file stacks-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the standard smooth-local-on-the-source-and-target criterion for a property of morphisms of algebraic spaces to be defined for a morphism of algebraic stacks, together with its variants for representable morphisms (author lemma at source lines 3236-3266, label lemma-local-source-target). The proof (source lines 3268-3369) derives the second condition from the first by composing smooth presentations, then proves the converse by building a large comparison diagram of algebraic spaces whose arrows are smooth as base changes or composites of the given ones, and transfers the property along the three parts of the smooth localness (proof lines 3319-3337); the representable cases are reduced to the corresponding characterisation for algebraic spaces and to a base change diagram with a scheme (proof lines 3340-3368). The comparison diagram with its four transport steps is the content. H3.
